Name: DC Burger Krobus for CP
Author: somohexual
Description:
[size=4][color=#ff0000][u][b]12/9/2020[/b][/u]
[b]THIS MOD IS [u]OUTDATED[/u] AND NO LONGER BEING SUPPORTED. 
I give permission to anyone that wants to use/alter my modified sprites.
[/b][/color][/size]

This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait Mod[/url] created ﻿by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]Tryptan (aka DCBurger)[/url] and is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3685]New Krobus to match DC Burger's Portraits[/url]﻿ created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53971052]Kitchenarm[/url]. I simply converted it into a Content Pack mod and added a few alternative options.

Now fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url]﻿ created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]﻿.


[u][b]Sprite Options:[/b][/u]
- Normal
- Normal (w/ mouth)
- Thicc 
- Thicc (w/ mouth)
- Xtra Thicc
- Xtra Thicc (w/ mouth)



[u][size=5]How to Install:[/size][/u]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3.[i] Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait Mod[/url] (recommended)[/i]
4. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
5. Pick which sprite you want to use and set it to "true" in the Config.json.
6. Make sure [b]ALL[/b] other options in Config.json are set to "false".
7. Run the game using SMAPI.

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.
